ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels (~5-8%) to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels (~92-95%) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly dark gray/black contiguous surface. Distinct high-contrast white focal spots and mottling are concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing edge. Multiple linear high-intensity streaks (rake marks) are mapped across the central and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute angle of approximately 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged irregularity and erosion are visible at both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve exhibiting a slight convexity near the median notch transitioning into a pronounced concave sweep toward the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, circular high-contrast pixel points consistent with barnacle scarring are visible at the distal tips and intermittently along the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of non-aligned, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) cutting across the primary dark pigmentation on both left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the surface and visible jagged erosion/irregularity on the trailing edge and distal tips.
